investigator.method: Level 1 PASSIVE_STATIC only: a single plain curl GET (descriptive User-Agent, no authentication, no browser) of the venue's official homepage revealed 100 separate <script type="application/ld+json"> schema.org MusicEvent blocks, one per upcoming event card, directly in the server-rendered HTML — no per-event crawling was needed at all.

probe_history.reason: A plain curl GET of the official homepage (a WordPress site) immediately exposed 100 separate, consistently-shaped schema.org MusicEvent JSON-LD blocks — one embedded per upcoming event card on the page itself — each with name, image, description, url, startDate, doorTime, a full venue address, and an offers array with a ticket URL. This directly and fully answers the investigation question at Level 1.

venue_reference: Privatclub (live-music club and event space, Skalitzer Straße 85-86, Kreuzberg, Berlin — in the basement of a former post office building)

identity.notes: Official identity confirmed directly from retained evidence: every sampled JSON-LD block's own 'location' names 'Privatclub Berlin' at 'Skalitzer Straße 85-86, 10997 Berlin', with 'sameAs': 'https://privatclub-berlin.de' (the site's own domain, self-referential) — consistent with independently-known venue facts.

site_classification.platform: WordPress (wp-content, wp-json Link headers present); the homepage itself embeds one schema.org MusicEvent JSON-LD block per upcoming event card — not gated behind a calendar plugin REST API.

title.notes: Each JSON-LD MusicEvent's own 'name' field, consistent across all 6 sampled blocks (e.g. 'BROTHER WALLACE', 'Gabriel Kelly - ABGESAGT / CANCELED', 'Anny Ogrezeanu').

start_date.notes: Each block's own 'startDate' field — a local datetime string with NO timezone/UTC offset at all (e.g. '2026-09-01T20:00'), honestly FLOATING_LOCAL rather than a genuine UTC instant. A separate 'doorTime' field (e.g. '19:00') is also present. The event's own 'description' field independently restates the same date/time in German prose (e.g. 'Konzert am Dienstag, 1. September 2026 um 20:00 Uhr im Privatclub Berlin'), corroborating the structured startDate.

time.notes: Time-of-day portion of the same 'startDate' field; a separate 'doorTime' field independently gives the doors time (e.g. '19:00').

end.notes: No 'endDate' or equivalent field is present in any of the 6 sampled blocks.

venue_location.notes: Each block's own 'location.name'/'location.address' (full PostalAddress: streetAddress/addressLocality/addressRegion/postalCode/addressCountry), identical across all 6 sampled events.

source_record_id.notes: No numeric or opaque id field is exposed. Each event's own 'url' field is a permanent-looking '/event/{slug}/' path (e.g. '/event/brother-wallace/') that this source itself uses as the record's own canonical address, matching the LAV/Moog precedent of treating a source's own URL slug as source_record_id. Left PARTIAL rather than PROVEN because this investigation did not independently re-observe the same slug across a repeated fetch to stress-test stability, consistent with how this same judgement call was made for Lido Berlin in this same trial.

price.notes: Each block's own 'offers' array contains only a ticket URL (no 'price'/'priceCurrency' value), pointing to a variety of third-party ticket sellers that differ per event (observed: greyzone-tickets.de, eventim.de) — the venue's own page never states a price value itself, only where to buy.

reasons: Identity PROVEN directly from retained first-party evidence.
acquisition_class JSON_LD_EVENT, a resolved supported class, confirmed across 100 total events on one page (6 sampled and retained).
A CONFIRMED public data path retained: one homepage fetch exposes every upcoming event's own JSON-LD block, the richest single-fetch yield of the six venues in this trial.
title, start_date, venue_location and event_url all PROVEN via DIRECT_SOURCE, cross-corroborated by each event's own German-language description text restating the same date/time.

source_record_id left honestly PARTIAL (URL-slug strategy plausible per existing project precedent, but not independently stress-tested within this investigation) and price left PARTIAL (only a ticket URL is present, never a stated value) — both are exactly the kind of detail an offline-proof/collector-build follow-up step should resolve.
recommended_family JSON_LD (an existing, already-implemented, reusable module — ingestion/json-ld/).
